failures.title: EVM backend raises Unknown opcode :SHR
failures.reason: The runtime header emits SHR, SHL, and GAS, and the assembler opcode map does not contain them. emit/1 raises before any bytecode exists.
failures.repro: Logos.Compiler.compile_to_evm on any contract with one clause.
failures.normative_expectation: compile_to_evm returns runtime and creation bytecode.
failures.removal_condition: A minimal contract compiles and the runtime header assembles, including SHR.
failures.evidence: lib/codegen/evm.ex header uses :SHR; lib/codegen/evm/assembler.ex opcode map has no SHR/SHL/GAS

failures.title: Transfer lowering emits a raw byte after PUSH1
failures.reason: compile_effect for :transfer places <<byte>> beside {:op, :PUSH1}. The assembler rejects that form in pass 1. Latent behind KF-EVM-UNKNOWN-SHR.
failures.repro: Inspect lib/codegen/evm.ex transfer sequence. Assembler case asm.raw-push shows the form is rejected.
failures.normative_expectation: Immediates are real PUSH instructions. ERC-20 calldata is 100 bytes.
failures.removal_condition: Transfer lowering uses {:push, bin} or {:push_u, n} and assembles.

failures.title: left_pad/2 recurses forever
failures.reason: The first clause matches every integer, so the k <= 0 clause is never reached.
failures.normative_expectation: Labelled jumps assemble in bounded time and land on JUMPDEST.
failures.removal_condition: The jump fixture returns bytecode within the watchdog.

failures.title: Jump placeholders are counted as 3 bytes and emitted as 4
failures.reason: Pass 1 adds 3 for jump_label. Pass 2 writes PUSH2, a 2-byte address, and JUMP. Masked at runtime by KF-ASM-LEFT-PAD.
failures.repro: Read resolve_labels/1 and encode1/2 for {:jump_label, name}.
failures.normative_expectation: Pass-1 size equals encoded size, and JUMPDEST is at the immediate's address.
failures.removal_condition: After left_pad returns, a forward jump's destination byte equals the label PC.
failures.evidence: lib/codegen/evm/assembler.ex pass 1 pc + 3 versus pass 2 PUSH2 encoding

failures.title: Duplicate labels are accepted
failures.reason: Map.put overwrites the previous PC. Two JUMPDESTs are emitted.
failures.normative_expectation: A duplicate label is a diagnostic.
failures.removal_condition: The duplicate-label fixture returns an error.

failures.title: push_u accepts integers wider than 32 bytes
failures.reason: 2^256 encodes as a 33-byte immediate and the opcode byte becomes 0x80, which is DUP1.
failures.normative_expectation: Values that do not fit in PUSH32 are rejected.
failures.removal_condition: The overflow fixture raises and does not emit 0x80.

failures.title: Undefined labels raise KeyError
failures.reason: Map.fetch! raises KeyError instead of an assembler diagnostic.
failures.normative_expectation: Undefined labels produce a structured assembler error.
failures.removal_condition: The fixture reports a dedicated undefined-label error rather than KeyError.

failures.title: Selectors and event topics use NIST SHA3-256
failures.reason: :crypto.hash(:sha3_256, sig) is not Ethereum Keccak-256. The hardcoded transferFrom selector 0x23b872dd is Keccak, so the two paths disagree.
failures.normative_expectation: Selectors and log topics are Keccak-256. transfer(address,uint256) is a9059cbb.
failures.removal_condition: Compiler-emitted selectors match the independent Keccak vectors.

failures.title: Comparisons push lhs then rhs and invert LT/GT
failures.reason: EVM LT/GT treat the top of stack as the first operand. The backend pushes lhs then rhs, so < becomes > and >= becomes <=.
failures.repro: parse_atom/3 in lib/codegen/evm.ex. Masked behind KF-EVM-UNKNOWN-SHR.
failures.normative_expectation: now >= start_ts + 7d is true at the deadline and false one second earlier.
failures.removal_condition: Deadline-1 reverts and the deadline succeeds for a >= guard.

failures.title: Unknown predicate names compile to PUSH 0
failures.reason: parse_term/3 pushes 0 for symbols that are not state, params, integers, or now.
failures.normative_expectation: An unknown name is a compile diagnostic and is never zero.
failures.removal_condition: The unknown-symbol fixture fails compilation.

failures.title: Selector dispatch consumes the selector
failures.reason: Each arm is PUSH selector; EQ; JUMPI with no DUP1, so the second clause underflows.
failures.normative_expectation: Each of three selectors reaches its own body. An unknown selector reverts.
failures.removal_condition: A three-clause dispatcher executes each body.

failures.title: Short-calldata check falls through into revert
failures.reason: The success label is never the jump target of a long payload, and :_revert_short is one shared atom.
failures.normative_expectation: Calldata shorter than 4 + 32*n reverts. A full payload continues.
failures.removal_condition: A two-argument call with 100 bytes enters the body and a truncated call reverts with no state change.

failures.title: CALL arguments are pushed in reverse order
failures.reason: CALL pops gas, address, value, in offset, in size, out offset, out size, with gas on top. The lowering leaves the return size on top.
failures.normative_expectation: transferFrom is a real CALL with 100-byte input and the success flag checked.
failures.removal_condition: An ERC-20 double that returns false rolls the transaction back.

failures.title: Successful CALL falls through into REVERT
failures.reason: The done label is the next instruction before the fail label's REVERT. RETURNDATACOPY is given two zeros instead of dest, offset, and size.
failures.normative_expectation: A canonical true return continues. A false, empty, or malformed return reverts. There is no fallthrough into the revert block.
failures.removal_condition: TokenTrue commits and TokenFalse reverts with state unchanged.

failures.title: Emit logs the wrong signature and drops data
failures.reason: Topics are SHA3 of Emitted(string) and the raw event name. LOG2 stack order uses those integers as offset and size. The data map is ignored. Solidity emits Emitted(string,string) instead.
failures.normative_expectation: Event topics match the declared Solidity-style signature and the data payload is ABI-encoded.
failures.removal_condition: A fixture event's topic0 matches Keccak of its canonical signature and the data is not dropped.
failures.evidence: lib/codegen/evm.ex emit lowering; lib/codegen/solidity.ex compile_effect for :emit

failures.title: Clause names and generated labels become atoms
failures.reason: build_runtime/2 calls String.to_atom on the clause name, and uniq/1 creates a fresh atom per internal label.
failures.repro: Repeated compile_to_evm with distinct clause names grows the atom table before the SHR error.
failures.normative_expectation: User identifiers do not allocate atoms.
failures.removal_condition: The evm atom-growth fixture reports growth 0.

failures.title: Solidity Transfer is an event, not an ERC-20 call
failures.reason: The backend emits TransferNote and hashes non-hex party names. Amounts are quoted strings.
failures.normative_expectation: Transfer performs transferFrom and reverts when the token returns false.
failures.removal_condition: Generated Solidity contains an external token call and no TransferNote placeholder.

failures.title: Non-hex party addresses crash Solidity emit
failures.reason: The parser stores {:raw, address} and solidity_addr/1 only matches binaries.
failures.normative_expectation: An invalid address is a diagnostic.
failures.removal_condition: The fixture returns a structured diagnostic rather than FunctionClauseError.

failures.title: Solidity copies now and Duration verbatim
failures.reason: Predicate rewrite only replaces and/or/not. now and Duration are not Solidity.
failures.repro: compile_to_solidity of a predicate containing now >= start_ts + Duration("7d").
failures.normative_expectation: now is block.timestamp and 7d is 604800 seconds.
failures.removal_condition: Generated Solidity typechecks under solc 0.8.28 for that predicate.

failures.title: End is optional and trailing input is discarded
failures.reason: parse/1 ignores the remainder after End, and End itself is optional.
failures.repro: A second contract after End still parses as the first contract.
failures.normative_expectation: Missing End and trailing garbage are diagnostics. Input is consumed completely.
failures.removal_condition: Both fixtures return a trailing-input diagnostic.

failures.title: One-line GoverningLaw is not the law section
failures.reason: The header must be a line that is exactly GoverningLaw. The documented one-liner is absorbed into the previous effect.
failures.repro: GoverningLaw "New York, USA" on the same line.
failures.normative_expectation: The documented one-line form sets contract.law.
failures.removal_condition: The one-line fixture sets law to New York, USA and does not rewrite the effect.

failures.title: If effects raise Protocol.UndefinedError
failures.reason: parse_effect/1 calls Enum.join on the then/else strings.
failures.repro: Shall If { cond: x == 0, then_: NoOp, else_: NoOp }.
failures.normative_expectation: If is an effect node with cond, then, and else.
failures.removal_condition: The fixture returns an :if effect.

failures.title: NoOp and Escrow become Note emits
failures.reason: The effect parser only recognizes Set, Emit, If, Transfer, and All. Everything else is a Note emit. Empty Shall is the only :noop.
failures.normative_expectation: NoOp is :noop. Escrow is a first-class effect.
failures.removal_condition: The keyword fixtures produce :noop and :escrow.

failures.title: Nested All is a Note emit
failures.reason: parse_effect_term/1 does not recognize All, so an inner All becomes raw text.
failures.normative_expectation: Nested All is an effect tree.
failures.removal_condition: The nested fixture's inner op is all and the Set is preserved.

failures.title: Ordinary syntax errors raise MatchError or CaseClauseError
failures.reason: A blank line before the first clause makes Regex.run return nil. A parameter with two colons misses the case clauses.
failures.repro: Blank line after Clauses, and Clause A(a:b:c).
failures.normative_expectation: These inputs return a diagnostic with a category and a location.
failures.removal_condition: Neither fixture raises MatchError or CaseClauseError.

failures.title: Duplicate parties and clauses are silent
failures.reason: Map.new keeps the last party or state field. Both clauses with the same name are kept.
failures.normative_expectation: Duplicate symbols are diagnostics.
failures.removal_condition: The duplicate-clause fixture is rejected.

failures.title: Unknown parameter types become uint256
failures.reason: Any annotation other than an address or bool prefix is :uint256, including Party.
failures.normative_expectation: An unknown type is a diagnostic.
failures.removal_condition: The Party parameter fixture does not produce :uint256.

failures.title: Whereas and Condition are dropped
failures.reason: Whereas is only a section boundary. Condition is not a syntactic form. Neither is stored on the AST.
failures.repro: A Whereas assert line, then parse. The AST has no whereas field.
failures.normative_expectation: Documented Whereas assertions and named Conditions are represented or rejected explicitly.
failures.removal_condition: The fixture either stores the assertion or returns a diagnostic. It does not succeed with the assertion deleted.
failures.evidence: lib/ast.ex Contract has no whereas field; lib/parser.ex drops the section
